set.body:
Carve-out of Interaction 12 (bd-01M1Z9B5A04BGXWJAAV57KDXNS) so a desktop host can use Intaglio interaction before selection algebra/inspectors/history (Interaction 10) exist. Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Depends only on Interaction 02 (state and events) and 03 (renderer-neutral picking). Interaction 12 keeps its full scope and acceptance; this issue delivers the minimal host layer it will build on.

Scope (javafx module; toolkit code stays out of core and shared interaction)
1. Input adapter: JavaFX mouse (move, press/click, drag, exit) and keyboard events on the canvas node become Interaction 02 actions on the FX application thread; revision-stamped as the controller requires.
2. Viewport mapping: one transform shared by rendering and picking, correct under HiDPI output scale and resize (device px <-> scene coordinates).
3. Hover and selection overlay redrawn without recompiling the scene, reusing the incremental-redraw work (closed bd-01M21YCF9MF81TDG542JC8SZM5).
4. Keyboard roving cursor: the plot is one focus stop; arrow keys move to the nearest mark in that direction via the picking plan's nearest query; Enter selects, Escape clears; the focused mark's accessible text comes from its semantic identity.
5. Externally controlled selection: the host can set selection/hover programmatically (projected input) without the adapter echoing it back as a user event.
6. Disposal removes every listener and cached image.

Acceptance criteria
1. Headless FX tests (xvfb/software pipeline) drive synthetic pointer and key events and assert the resulting interaction events and selected keys, including at output scale 2.
2. Pointer-to-highlight latency and overlay redraw latency measured for a 10,000-mark scatter on a named machine; recorded, not advertised as a budget until Interaction 11.
3. Keyboard-only selection of any mark in a scatter and a tile plot.
4. Projected selection does not emit user events (test).
5. 1,000 attach/dispose cycles leave no retained listeners (weak-reference test).
6. Headless recording tests are not reported as native desktop proof (Interaction 12's evidence rule still applies to 12).

Exclusions
Region/lasso selection and pan/zoom (Interaction 05); inspectors, filters and history (Interaction 10); browser parity.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 12a] Minimal JavaFX interaction host: pointer/keyboard input, viewport mapping, overlay redraw and external selection
